_comment: The segmentation corpus. Replaces a single reference model + exact output hash.
Why ranges and not a hash: a hash of one model's per-triangle labels forbids ALL
change. Any tuning that helps a second model breaks the first model's fingerprint,
and with only one model in the lockfile there is no way to weigh the trade -- only
to observe that something moved. That is a ratchet against improvement.
status 'required' -> must stay inside its range; the gate blocks if it does not.
status 'failing'  -> a known gap, tracked not hidden. Reported loudly, never blocks.
If it starts passing the gate says so and asks you to promote it.
The ratchet now points the right way: quality can only be locked in, never locked out.
The corpus pulls in BOTH directions on purpose. peanut and grooved must split;
shallowDimple, noisyBall and ball must not. A change that only ever loosens
merging passes half of these and shatters the other half -- which is exactly what
happened while fixing peanut, and is why noisyBall exists.

fixtures.name: twoBalls
fixtures.why: two physically separate spheres — connected components alone must split these

fixtures.name: ball
fixtures.why: convex everywhere; over-segmenting a smooth sphere means the curvature threshold is chasing noise

fixtures.name: shallowDimple
fixtures.why: a ~8 degree styling dent is not a seam - this is the case boundary-strength merging exists for

fixtures.name: noisyBall
fixtures.why: voxel-staircase texture is noise, not structure; the guard against any change that loosens merging
note: Scoring boundaries by per-FACE curvature, or by a one-ring dilation of it, shatters
this into 18 parts while still fixing peanut. Reach is as important as the statistic:
stay on the per-edge smoothed field. See BOUNDARY_PERCENTILE in segment.ts.

fixtures.name: grooved
fixtures.why: a deep groove cut around a bar; must yield two comparable halves, not one bar plus a thin ring

fixtures.name: peanut
fixtures.why: two lobes meeting at a ~77 degree concave crease - the most obvious split there is
note: Reading boundary strength at a percentile instead of a mean fixes this. Measured
against reference/diablo.glb, it also splits the DOOR into its inner and outer
skin (83423 tris -> 42639 + 40784). Touching the door would then hand you half a
door, which breaks the core interaction. Not worth a synthetic fixture.
